[[File:Cracian_thumper1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The messenger rides a Cracian thumper to Joruus C'baoth's High Castle.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonist on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]] brought news on [[Cracian thumper]]back to [[Joruus C'baoth]] while the latter awaited the arrival of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. He traveled from a cluster of villages at the base of the rim mountains to the gate in front of C'baoth's [[High Castle]], where he dismounted and waited to be seen.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
